source_full: Who had had nothing to eat for two days and was very hungry. The door of the pit was hardly closed when the bear rushed at the shepherd but when it saw his eyes it was so frightened that it was ready to eat itself. It shrank away into a corner and gazed at him from there, and, in spite of being so famished, did not dare to touch him,
target_full: 两天没吃东西，非常饥饿。陷阱的门刚关上，熊就冲向牧羊人，但当它看到他的眼睛时，吓得几乎要吃掉自己。它缩到角落里，从那里盯着他，尽管饿得厉害，却不敢碰他。
